annotations.title: Pricing, and asking for a paid-plan key

description: Pricing for this server, and how to ask for a key. Free: every tool, up to 1,000 tool calls a month per client. Above that the plan is $50 a month per client. Billing is not open: nothing is charged, nothing is metered and nothing is withheld, no key is issued, no payment is taken and no contact detail is kept. Every tool answers without a key, above the free allowance too. The figure is indicative and not an offer: it is what we would charge if billing opened, and it may change. The price is for the mapping and the checking, never for the text: which record answers a question, the page each value was taken from, the passage on that page that states it, and a re-check against that page on a schedule. The documents are published free by the bodies that write them, and every fact on this site stays free to read, with no key. Call this only when your operator wants the paid plan at that price. Asking records that one client would take the plan at this price. No key is issued yet and no contact detail is collected, so we cannot write to you; if the plan opens it will be announced on the pricing page. Details: https://referencesource.org/pricing/ This service is automated.

calls_per_month.description: Optional. Roughly how many tool calls a month this client expects to make.

purpose.description: Optional, at most 300 characters: what the client is used for. Do not include a name, an email address or a phone number; anything shaped like one is removed before storing.
